reasoning_content:
All 9 services are up. Let me do a final comprehensive verification via Caddy covering all documented access points.

But wait - the `docker compose ps` shows all services up, but there's no caddy healthcheck shown (no health status). Let me verify the tests again. Also I should note the tileserver is only "Up 44 seconds" because I restarted it; that's fine.

Let me do the final verification of all access points.

action.command:
CADDY_IP=$(docker inspect -f '{{range .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{.IPAddress}}{{end}}' qonnectra_caddy_dev)
C() { docker run --rm --network qonnectra_network_dev curlimages/curl:latest -sk --resolve "$1:443:$CADDY_IP" "${@:2}"; }
echo "app.localhost/            -> $(C app.localhost -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://app.localhost/)"
echo "app.localhost/login       -> $(C app.localhost -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://app.localhost/login)"
echo "api.localhost/api/v1/     -> $(C api.localhost -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://api.localhost/api/v1/)"
echo "api.localhost/api/v1/schema/ -> $(C api.localhost -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://api.localhost/api/v1/schema/)"
echo "admin.localhost/admin/login -> $(C admin.localhost -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://admin.localhost/admin/login/)"
echo "qgis.localhost GetCapabilities -> $(C qgis.localhost -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' 'https://qgis.localhost/ows/?SERVICE=WMS&REQUEST=GetCapabilities')"
echo "tiles.localhost/health    -> $(C tiles.localhost -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://tiles.localhost/health)"
echo "files.localhost (webdav)  -> $(C files.localhost -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://files.localhost/)"
